Astro Block

About Astro Block

Astro Block is a 3D space puzzle game. Roll a glowing block across floating platforms, activate switches to open bridges, and reach the portal standing upright. Each of the 30 levels asks you to plan a safe route through increasingly difficult layouts.

How to play

Move Swipe on the board on mobile On desktop use the arrow keys or WASD Stay on the path Every part of the block must be supported by a platform Reach the portal upright Lying across the portal will not finish the level Use special tiles Colored
